atoms.a: She was talking on the phone when her mother came in her room.

instruction.text: Wähle das jeweilige Verb in der genannten Zeitform aus.

atoms.b: He ((++danced have_danced had_danced)) at the party last night.
I ((++was_packing have_been_packing had_been_packing)) my school bag when my sister interrupted me.
She ((++has_seen had_seen saw)) the film twice.
Her mother ((++has_been_working had_been_working was_working)) as a pilot for over 25 years.
We went home after we ((++had_eaten have_eaten ate)) sushi at the restaurant.
I ((++had_been_trying has_been_trying was_trying)) to find my sunglasses all day.

instruction.text: Vervollständige die Sätze, indem du die Verben in der richtigen Zeitform einsetzt.

atoms.b: He ((++swam swims)) in the lake yesterday.
They ((++were_having have_had)) a picnic in the park when it started to rain heavily.
She ((++has_read has_been_reading)) that book already.
I ((++have_been_living had_been_living)) in Australia for 15 years.
Her father ((++had_directed was_directing)) twenty films already before he started working on his current film.
His mother ((++had_been_driving drove)) cars for 10 years before she started using public transportation.
